title: Chapter
description: A chapter as the manifest lists it: its identity and how it starts. The chapter's text (Rosetta Markdown) is not part of this; it is read and written with ProjectStore.loadChapter and saveChapter, by id.

id.description: Chosen when the chapter is added and never changed, so renaming or reordering keeps the text.

pages.description: How many pages the chapter had when it was last laid out, counting a blank page before it. The next chapter's first page number is this chapter's first page number plus this. Absent until the chapter has been laid out.

stale.description: True when something before this chapter has changed since it was laid out (an earlier chapter got longer or shorter, or chapters were added, removed or moved), so its first page number, and with it whether it needs a blank page, may be out of date. Absent means not stale.

start.description: Every chapter starts on a new page. right-page starts it on a right-hand page. Absent means next-page.
